title: Interval certification of selected equal-mass three-body periodic brake orbits
description: Article and 23 saved certificates for thirteen row-associated parameter boxes, with ten same-zero comparisons across flow implementations. Exact rational terminal and table checks are included; full ODE integration is not part of the default checks. Code is Apache-2.0; original text and generated data are CC BY 4.0; third-party numerical excerpts retain their original terms.
